expectations.text: Left the skill files unchanged (nothing applied before approval)
Names the version-source learning (__about__.py, dynamic, or hatch)
Flags --skip-existing as unsafe or to avoid
Routes nothing to docker-deploy (unused in the session)
Does not promote the 'pyhton' typo or the 429 feature to a learning

expectations.evidence: Proposal 1 rewrites pypi-release's "Bump the version" section to find where the version lives (dynamic, hatch path, __about__.py) before editing, and says not to alter build config.
Proposal 2 changes pypi-release's Build section to run rm -rf dist/ first and its Upload section to forbid --skip-existing.
Both proposals give the exact replacement markdown for the sections, plus the full resulting file, so they can be applied without rereading the session.

Both proposals rest on events in the session (the dynamic-version build error and the stale dist/ with --skip-existing). Neither is routed to docker-deploy, and the pyhton typo is mentioned only as not proposed.
The document is titled "Skill edit proposals" and describes the changes as edits to "Replace". The "Resulting" file is labeled "both proposals applied" and never says the files were changed.
